execution_policy: Synthetic Ed25519 test keys only; no production identity keys or live identity records.

cases.scenario: Valid root-to-tip single-parent chain with signed proof for each node, exact parent links, unique subjects/nonces and increasing epochs.
cases.expected: Lineage accepted with deterministic chain digest.

cases.scenario: Invalid signature, digest substitution, unknown key, revoked key or unavailable revocation state.
cases.expected: Fail closed; no valid lineage claim.

cases.scenario: Cycle, duplicate subject, missing parent or incorrect predecessor.
cases.expected: Fail closed; all links must match the preceding node.

cases.scenario: Epoch regression, expired/future proof, excessive proof TTL or repeated nonce.
cases.expected: Fail closed; temporal and uniqueness constraints enforced.

cases.scenario: Candidate tip differs from last verified node or attempts unsupported merge relationship.
cases.expected: Fail closed; only single-parent lineage is accepted.
